arxiv-1705-02349.title: Slim Fractals: The Geometry of Doubly Transient Chaos
arxiv-1705-02349.creator: Xiaowen Chen, Takashi Nishikawa, Adilson E. Motter
arxiv-1705-02349.description: Abstract Traditional studies of chaos in conservative and driven dissipative systems have established a correspondence between sensitive dependence on initial conditions and fractal basin boundaries, but much less is known about the relation between geometry and dynamics in undriven dissipative systems.

arxiv-2202-12725.title: An Improvement on the Hotelling T 2 T^{2} Test Using the Ledoit-Wolf Nonlinear Shrinkage Estimator
arxiv-2202-12725.creator: Benjamin Robinson, Robert Malinas, Van Latimer, Beth Bjorkman Morrison, Alfred O. Hero, III
arxiv-2202-12725.description: Abstract Hotelling’s T 2 T^{2} test is a classical approach for discriminating the means of two multivariate normal samples that share a population covariance matrix. Hotelling’s test is not ideal for high-dimensional samples because the eigenvalues of the estimated sample covariance matrix are inconsistent estimators for their population counterparts.

arxiv-2501-17807.title: Readout-induced leakage of the fluxonium qubit
arxiv-2501-17807.creator: Aayam Bista, Matthew Thibodeau, Ke Nie, Kaicheung Chow, Bryan K Clark, Angela Kou
arxiv-2501-17807.description: Abstract Dispersive readout is widely used to perform high-fidelity measurement of superconducting qubits. Much work has been focused on the qubit readout fidelity, which depends on the achievable signal-to-noise ratio and the qubit relaxation time. As groups have pushed to increase readout fidelity by increasing readout photon number, dispersive readout has been shown to strongly affect the post-measurement qubit state.

arxiv-2506-10131.title: Positron Signal from the Early Universe
arxiv-2506-10131.creator: Leo Stodolsky
arxiv-2506-10131.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Leo Stodolsky. Bursts from the very early universe may lead to a detectable signal via the production of positrons, whose annihilation gives an observable X-ray signal. Using the absorption parameters for the annihilation photons of 511 keV, it is found that observable photons would orginate at a redshift around z ≈ 200 − − 300 z\approx 200--300 , resulting in soft X-rays of energy ∼ 2 − − 3 ​ k ​ e ​ V \sim 2--3\,keV at present.

arxiv-2511-00879.title: Assessing LLM Reasoning Steps via Principal Knowledge Grounding
arxiv-2511-00879.creator: Hyeon Hwang Yewon Cho Chanwoong Yoon Yein Park Minju Song, Kyungjae Lee Gangwoo Kim Jaewoo Kang, Korea University University of Seoul AWS AI Labs AIGEN Sciences{hyeon-hwang, yewon330, kangj}@korea.ac.kr
arxiv-2511-00879.description: Abstract Step-by-step reasoning has become a standard approach for large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex tasks. While this paradigm has proven effective, it raises a fundamental question: How can we verify that an LLM’s reasoning is accurately grounded in knowledge? To address this question, we introduce a novel evaluation suite that systematically assesses the knowledge grounding of intermediate reasoning.

pmc-10566084.title: The role of a starch-based diet in solving existential challenges for the 21st century
pmc-10566084.creator: John McDougall
pmc-10566084.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Diet plays a fundamental role in our major chronic diseases, in climate change, and in our resistance to infectious diseases. The eating patterns that best support the health of people and our planet are based on traditional starchy staples. Historically, a wide variety of starches have provided the bulk of the food for most of the people who have walked our Earth.

pmc-10567616.title: Prioritised identification of structural classes of natural products from higher plants in the expedition of antimalarial drug discovery
pmc-10567616.creator: Phanankosi Moyo, Luke Invernizzi, Sephora M Mianda, Wiehan Rudolph, Andrew W Andayi, Mingxun Wang, Neil R Crouch, Vinesh J Maharaj
pmc-10567616.description: The emergence and spread of drug-recalcitrant Plasmodium falciparum parasites threaten to reverse the gains made in the fight against malaria. Urgent measures need to be taken to curb this impending challenge. The higher plant-derived sesquiterpene, quinoline alkaloids, and naphthoquinone natural product classes of compounds have previously served as phenomenal chemical scaffolds from which integral antimalarial drugs were developed.

pmc-11402888.title: Prognostic determinants in cancer survival: a multidimensional evaluation of clinical and genetic factors across 10 cancer types in the participants of Genomics England’s 100,000 Genomes Project
pmc-11402888.creator: Jurgita Gammall, Alvina G Lai
pmc-11402888.description: BackgroundCancer is a complex disease, caused and impacted by a combination of genetic, demographic, clinical, environmental and lifestyle factors. Analysis of cancer characteristics, risk factors, treatment options and the heterogeneity across cancer types has been the focus of medical research for years.

pmc-11455404.title: 7822 Mild Autonomous Cortisol Secretion In High Suspicious Adrenal Incidentaloma
pmc-11455404.creator: Nino Zavrashvili, Natia Margvelashvili, Ketevan Chanturishvili
pmc-11455404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Margvelashvili: None. Chanturishvili: None.Mild Autonomous Cortisol Secretion in High Suspicious Adrenal IncidentalomaIntroduction: Incidentally discovered adrenal masses are common and mostly benign and non-functioning adenomas. However, evolving evidence suggests that a notable proportion of these adrenal adenomas may demonstrate mild autonomous cortisol secretion (MACS), which has been associated with an increased risk for hypertension, hyperglycemia, obesity, dyslipidemia, vertebral fractures, adverse cardiovascular events, and mortality. 55-year-old women with 5-year history of hypertension and hyperlipidemia.

pmc-11490887.creator: Ting Zhang, Qian Liu, Quan Chen, Hao Wu
pmc-11490887.description: Trace elemental iron is an essential nutrient that participates in diverse metabolic processes. Dysregulation of cellular iron homeostasis, both iron deficiency and iron overload, is detrimental and tightly associated with disease pathogenesis. IRPs-IREs system is located at the center for iron homeostasis regulation.

pmc-11700533.title: A Case of Ossified Tissue Misdiagnosed as Amyloid Deposits by Congo Red Stain and Birefringence
pmc-11700533.creator: Hajime Iwata, Jotaro Nakashima, Tomonori Kai, Haruka Okada
pmc-11700533.description: Pulmonary amyloidosis is diagnosed by identifying amyloid deposits using Congo red stain (CR) and birefringence under polarized light. However, collagen fibers can also produce similar staining results, complicating diagnosis. We report a case of a 55-year-old male patient with lung opacities, initially suspected to have amyloidosis based on CR positivity and green birefringence.

pmc-12399095.title: Exosomes-Based Nanotherapeutic Strategies: An Important Approach for Spinal Cord Injury Repair
pmc-12399095.creator: Cheng Ju, Hui Dong, Renfeng Liu, Xuan Wang, Ruiqing Xu, Huimin Hu, Dingjun Hao
pmc-12399095.description: The repair and functional regeneration of spinal cord injury (SCI) remains a major challenge and focal point in regenerative medicine. Following SCI significant inflammation and neuronal damage occur. Conventional drug therapies often fail to precisely target the injured areas and cannot cross the blood-spinal cord barrier, severely limiting therapeutic efficacy.

pmc-12425747.title: Associations between systemic inflammatory indices and the risk of renal function decline in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12425747.creator: Zhi Shang, Hai-Dong Zhang, Hui Qian, Yue-Ming Gao, Song-Tao Feng
pmc-12425747.description: AimsThis study aimed to investigate the associations between three systemic inflammatory indices, including the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), systemic inflammation response index (SIRI), and pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV), and the risk of renal function decline in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).MethodsWe consecutively enrolled 9,537 patients with T2DM hospitalized at Peking University Third Hospital.

pmc-13324425.title: Performance evaluation of machine learning algorithms for predicting liquefaction-induced lateral displacement
pmc-13324425.creator: Mahmood Ahmad, Mohammad Al Zubi, Shaikat Biswas, Abdur Rahman Rakib, Abdullah Alzlfawi, Sabahat Hussan, Shay Haq, Rohayu Che Omar, Zia Ullah, Zsolt Tóth
pmc-13324425.description: Accurate prediction of liquefaction-induced lateral displacement is essential for seismic risk assessment, resilient infrastructure design, and cost-effective mitigation. Such predictions are complex and cannot be reliably addressed using conventional analytical approaches. This research utilizes XGBoost, CatBoost and AdaBoost algorithms with 247 post-liquefaction in-situ free-face ground condition case studies to model and investigate liquefaction induced lateral displacements.

pmc-13417813.title: Aflrpn4 Represents a Promising Target for Mitigating Aspergillus flavus Growth and Aflatoxin Contamination
pmc-13417813.creator: Xingsai Liu, Yanli Xin, Kashif Iqbal Sahibzada, Xiujia Zhang, Cunjian Tu, Shan Wei, Yuansen Hu, Yangyong Lv
pmc-13417813.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Aspergillus flavus and its primary secondary metabolite, aflatoxin B1, pose a persistent threat to global food security and public health, highlighting the need to identify novel molecular targets for the development of highly specific fungicides. In this study, the transcription factor Aflrpn4 was investigated by constructing gene deletion and complementation strains to elucidate its regulatory mechanisms in controlling the growth, development, and pathogenicity of A.

pmc-13464257.title: Incidental Right Atrial Myxoma
pmc-13464257.creator: Michael Z.L. Zhu, Thiruvashrin Chetty, Rohan V. Navani, Casey Lo, Cheng He
pmc-13464257.description: BackgroundPrimary cardiac tumors are rare with an estimated incidence of 200 cases per million people (0.02%). Right atrial myxomas account for only 8% to 15% of these cases and may present incidentally, with nonspecific symptoms, or with embolic or obstructive complications. Prompt surgical excision is essential given risks of embolization, obstruction, and sudden cardiopulmonary compromise.
